YOUR FIRST CONVERSATION

$talk-to-plan I want to build a bookmarking tool. Help me see the big picture first. Let’s discuss it piece by piece and document decisions once I explicitly approve them.

Make it your own project. Then talk naturally; there is no need to repeat the skill name.

A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you start.
A few useful answers.

When should I use it?+

Use it when planning a project, designing a complex feature, or exploring architecture. You can also continue an existing project: the AI starts by reading the context you already have.

Will it make decisions for me?+

The skill keeps you in charge of the important decisions. AI explains and advises, then documents only what you explicitly approve. “Sounds good” is not automatically treated as a final decision.

Where does the design document live?+

It updates the document you choose or your existing main design document, creating one only when needed. It records decisions, reasons, boundaries, and topics you defer. File operations depend on your AI tool and its permissions.

Do I have to work out every detail?+

No. You can agree on a direction and leave implementation details for later. Change topics, revisit an idea, or stop when you have enough clarity for the next step.

Which tools can I use it with?+

The project is developed and used in Codex. The installer offers AI tool options, and other skill-compatible tools can load it in their own way. The discussion experience may vary across tools and models.
